signal: PlanSource unveiled a brand evolution in January 2026 after a year of AI-driven transformation and was named UKG 2025 Innovator of the Year for connected benefits.

email.body1:
Chris, saw PlanSource's brand evolution this year and the UKG Innovator of the Year nod for connected benefits.

A repositioning like that usually generates more in-market accounts than business development can reach before the interest cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PlanSource off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Chris, quick follow-up for PlanSource.

After a rebrand and AI push, pipeline targets tend to climb faster than headcount, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PlanSource needs this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Chris, last bit of proof for PlanSource.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PlanSource's reply rate likely compares to other HR tech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Chris, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A rebrand keeps the business development team busy for a while.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your BD motion? I'll tailor it to PlanSource either way.
